npcs.name: Jor Sandline
npcs.description: Jor holds down the caravan yard outside the north gate with callused competence and open ears.
npcs.biography: Jor did not plan to become the town's go-to caravan master, yet the caravan yard outside the north gate made the choice sticky. Now 39, the Human measures success in quiet evenings and unpaid favors returned. He pays in mixed coin to learn who notices, and keeps the route book bound in camel hide like a confessor keeps secrets. Deals with Orrin; uses Skog's stables; hires Jab. Hope pulls one way—secure Orrin's spice contract exclusively—while caution pulls the other because of losing a season to bandits or tariffs. Offered Jab double to deliver to the mill without a waybill copy.
npcs.personality: Warm with regulars, curt with wasters; pays in mixed coin to learn who notices.
npcs.motivation: Secure enough ground to secure Orrin's spice contract exclusively.
npcs.secret: Quietly arranging matters around: Offered Jab double to deliver to the mill without a waybill copy.
npcs.rumor: A smugglers' mark was seen near the caravan yard outside the north gate on a night Jor worked late.
npcs.voice: Polite public voice; sharper private asides when trust appears.
npcs.appearance: Looks like someone who sleeps lightly; distinctive detail is the route book bound in camel hide.

npcs.name: Kavi Greenhood
npcs.description: Familiar face at forest margins and game trails; useful, stubborn, and hard to surprise.
npcs.biography: People looking for a reliable wilderness scout are sent to Kavi, who claims forest margins and game trails as home ground. At 128, this Elf has learned to watch hands before faces. She leaves stacked stones as silent letters; neighbors joke that she would miss a coronation before misplacing the green hood faded almost gray. Walks with Yara; reports odd trails to Serra sometimes. She is saving courage and coin alike to keep a safe trail for pilgrims and herbalists, while trying not to let town politics spilling into the woods decide the ending. Found Yara's feverwort patch flagged with chalk arrows toward the mill.
npcs.personality: Proud of competence more than praise; leaves stacked stones as silent letters.
npcs.motivation: Protect her place at forest margins and game trails long enough to keep a safe trail for pilgrims and herbalists.
npcs.secret: Has not told allies that found Yara's feverwort patch flagged with chalk arrows toward the mill.
npcs.rumor: A smugglers' mark was seen near forest margins and game trails on a night Kavi worked late.
npcs.voice: Measured elf cadence; concrete nouns before adjectives.
npcs.appearance: Work-worn elf garb; green hood faded almost gray always nearby.

npcs.name: Rilo Songpenny
npcs.description: Familiar face at roads, fairs, and Mira's stage; useful, stubborn, and hard to surprise.
npcs.biography: Rilo learned the hard corners of town by working them as a traveling minstrel based out of roads, fairs, and Mira's stage. At 27, the Half-Elf has a map of loyalties written in calluses rather than ink. Day after day he collects rumors the way others collect coins, and the cape lined with song scraps marks his place in the room. Sometimes rooms with Nessa; carries news. His north star is to be hired by Dame Orla for a full season. The shadow at his heels is singing the wrong satire in the wrong hall. Heard sailors say Nedda's barge 'rides light and smells bright'.
npcs.personality: Proud of competence more than praise; collects rumors the way others collect coins.
npcs.motivation: Protect his place at roads, fairs, and Mira's stage long enough to be hired by Dame Orla for a full season.
npcs.secret: Has not told allies that heard sailors say Nedda's barge 'rides light and smells bright'.
npcs.rumor: Someone paid Rilo to forget a name connected to roads, fairs, and Mira's stage.
npcs.voice: Measured half-elf cadence; concrete nouns before adjectives.
npcs.appearance: Work-worn half-elf garb; cape lined with song scraps always nearby.

npcs.name: Asha Roadbless
npcs.description: Asha holds down temple steps and road shrines with callused competence and open ears.
npcs.biography: Asha Roadbless keeps temple steps and road shrines running with the stubborn patience of a 50-year-old Human who has already survived worse seasons than this one. She washes her feet before every gate, and the walking staff carved with mercy marks is usually within reach when tempers rise. Guest of Elen's temple; rejected Orin. Her private aim is plain enough: reach three temples before winter. Still, she flinches at the thought of faithful folk turned away for being poor. Lately the trouble under her nose is this: Was offered 'safe passage' papers by Pale Orin for a 'donation'.
npcs.personality: Warm with regulars, curt with wasters; washes her feet before every gate.
npcs.motivation: Secure enough ground to reach three temples before winter.
npcs.secret: Quietly arranging matters around: Was offered 'safe passage' papers by Pale Orin for a 'donation'.
npcs.rumor: Asha is writing a private list of debts the council will not touch.
npcs.voice: Polite public voice; sharper private asides when trust appears.
npcs.appearance: Looks like someone who sleeps lightly; distinctive detail is the walking staff carved with mercy marks.

npcs.name: Tem Brine
npcs.description: The river sailor people recommend when they actually want the job finished.
npcs.biography: People looking for a reliable river sailor are sent to Tem, who claims river wharf and midstream as home ground. At 34, this Human has learned to watch hands before faces. He reads water the way scholars read books; neighbors joke that he would miss a coronation before misplacing the rope calluses like badges. Works docks with Mael; cleaner than Nedda. He is saving courage and coin alike to captain his own flatboat next year, while trying not to let fog collisions near the mill race decide the ending. Refused to tow Nedda after smelling her 'grain'.
npcs.personality: Soft-spoken until principles are poked; reads water the way scholars read books.
npcs.motivation: Turn today's scrapes into tomorrow's chance to captain his own flatboat next year.
npcs.secret: Night thoughts keep returning to fog collisions near the mill race, especially since: Refused to tow Nedda after smelling her 'grain'.
npcs.rumor: Someone paid Tem to forget a name connected to river wharf and midstream.
npcs.voice: Quick river-town diction, then sudden silences that mean more than words.
npcs.appearance: Easy to spot near river wharf and midstream: human, practical layers, and that rope calluses like badges.

npcs.name: Vessa Coldtrail
npcs.description: Local game hunter whose days orbit cold camps beyond the tree line and small lasting loyalties.
npcs.biography: Walk into cold camps beyond the tree line and you will find Vessa Coldtrail before you find a free chair. A 31-year-old Half-Orc game hunter, Vessa greets trouble the way other folk greet weather: with a coat and a plan. She shares meat before she shares names. The fur roll tied with sinew travels with her almost everywhere. Friends with Skog; confirms Kavi's trail signs. Her ambition is to sell honest furs without guild bribes. Her nightmare is overhunting for noble fashion. Right now, Tracked armed strangers caching rope near the mill at dusk.
npcs.personality: Dry humor over a careful heart; shares meat before she shares names.
npcs.motivation: Finish one honest plan: sell honest furs without guild bribes.
npcs.secret: Keeps proof related to a problem—Tracked armed strangers caching rope near the mill at dusk.
npcs.rumor: Vessa can open doors at cold camps beyond the tree line after hours—if asked the right way.
npcs.voice: Storyteller rhythm even when discussing ledgers or latches.
npcs.appearance: Half-Orc features shaped by work at cold camps beyond the tree line; watch for the fur roll tied with sinew.

npcs.name: Blink Feather
npcs.description: A long-road courier rooted at the long road in all weather, known for how he never sleeps in the same loft twice.
npcs.biography: Blink Feather's reputation as a long-road courier was built one careful errand at a time around the long road in all weather. Age 23 sits lightly on this Halfling, except when old debts creak. Watch long enough and you will see that he never sleeps in the same loft twice. The sealable message tube worn as a belt is part tool, part talisman. Idol for Finn; professional pride. He would trade sleep to hire Finn as a second when the boy is ready, yet stays wary of being forced to open a letter. Current spark: Carried a sealed note from Kitty Shade to someone inside Vale Manor.
npcs.personality: Steady and sharp-eyed; never sleeps in the same loft twice.
npcs.motivation: To hire Finn as a second when the boy is ready without feeding being forced to open a letter.
npcs.secret: Knows more about this than he admits: Carried a sealed note from Kitty Shade to someone inside Vale Manor.
npcs.rumor: Blink can open doors at the long road in all weather after hours—if asked the right way.
npcs.voice: Low and practical, with a habit of repeating the important clause once.
npcs.appearance: A halfling silhouette framed by the long road in all weather, hands seldom empty of the sealable message tube worn as a belt.

relationships.note: Wants to become a real long-road courier.
